# TestScript for 16-help-variables
# Contrasts the automatic constraint hint with the {{...}} help-variable
# alternative, which states the constraint once and suppresses the matching hint.

# 1. Automatic form appends the bracket hint after the help text
exec helpvars --help
stdout '--automatic=8080\s+Port using the automatic hint \[1\.\.65535\]'

# 2. Inlined form states the bound in prose and suppresses the bracket hint
stdout '(?m)^\s*--inlined=8080\s+Port stated once \(1\.\.65535\)\s*$'
! stdout '(?m)^\s*--inlined=8080.*\['

# 3. {{enum}}, {{items}}, and {{env}} inline the declared values
stdout '--environment=STRING\s+Environment \(dev, staging, prod\)'
! stdout '\[enum:'
stdout '--zones=STRING,\.\.\.\s+Availability zones \(2\.\.3 items\)'
! stdout '\[items:'
stdout '--region=STRING\s+Region \(from REGION\)'
! stdout '\[env:'

# 4. {{default}} moves the default into the prose; the value slot shows the type
stdout '--profile=STRING\s+Build profile \(default dev\)'
! stdout '\[default:'

# 5. A literal {{ is written by doubling the opening braces
stdout '--literal=STRING\s+Literal braces: \{\{not-a-variable\}\}'

# 6. Running with values resolves the flags
exec helpvars --inlined 9000 --environment prod --zones a --zones b
stdout 'inlined'
